summary: the whole substrate tower on one axis -- the cover figure for w33_everything.tex. Panel A: a forest plot of every measured observable's fractional agreement |pred-obs|/obs (log scale) -- the mass/coupling postdictions (m_p/m_e, 1/alpha, sin^2 th_W, M_Z, CC, m_H) cluster at 0.01-0.3% (integer/LO), the inflation/neutrino observables (A_s, n_s, alpha_s, Dm^2 ratio, sin^2 th_23, Omega_DM/Omega_b) at 1-5%, each within its measurement error; zero off the chart. Panel B: the dated kill-shots 2025-2040 -- m_DM (LZ ~2028), first r hint (SO ~2027), Dm^2 ratio (JUNO), Sum m_nu (DESI/CMB-S4), m_betabeta (nEXO/LEGEND), headline r=1/300 (LiteBIRD ~2035). One figure shows the over-determination (one q=3 alphabet, ~20 numbers, all consistent) AND the dated falsifiability. HONEST: the common axis is fractional deviation not sigma (mixes integer/LO postdictions with measurement-limited points; caption says so); a presentation of the scorecard, not a new result; dates are published schedules. Emits w33_tower_falsification_fig.tex (two-panel figure).
